name: Elements Public House

nadir.desc: The property holds a multi-story commercial building with a brown multi-gabled shingle roof and light exterior walls|A flat roof terrace with outdoor tables and chairs occupies one side of the roof|Asphalt parking lots flank the east and west sides of the building, with marked parking spaces against the street|Landscaped grass strips and trees ring the parcel|A multi-lane road with a center turn lane runs along the street frontage|A fenced dumpster enclosure sits at one corner of the larger parking lot.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces NW 6th St under a covered porch supported by columns|Large glass windows and doors open onto the porch, and a business sign is mounted above the entry|Marked parking spaces, including handicapped accessible spaces, sit between the building and the road|The parking lot is directly accessed from NW 6th Street|A sidewalk and a narrow landscaped strip run along the street edge.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the parking lot wrapping the building|Marked parking spaces, light poles, and landscaped islands with grass and trees fill that lot|A fenced dumpster enclosure stands near the outer edge of the lot|Trees line parts of the perimeter|The multi-lane road remains visible in front of the building.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows light exterior walls, windows, and a raised outdoor deck with tables and chairs|Roof mechanical units and vents are visible on the shingled roof|The larger parking lot continues behind the building, and trees stand along the rear edge of the property|Pavement in the lot shows cracking across several parking spaces.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the front parking lot between the building and NW 6th St|A dumpster enclosure, a small detached building and a strip of grass flank the building on this side|An exterior staircase leads to the back deck|Landscaping and trees sit between the parking lot and the sidewalk|Access from the highway into the front parking area is visible at this end of the site.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from NW 6th St into the parking lots on both sides of the building. Circulation space is open in the larger lot behind the building and more restrictive in the front lot. The covered front porch and the raised rear deck are exterior gathering areas with stair access to the deck. A dumpster enclosure sits in the larger lot. No gates are visible from the imagery.
clarifications: Which door is the primary public entrance, and is there a rear or service door? Is the raised deck open to the public or restricted? Are any driveway openings closed or gated after hours? What is stored in the fenced enclosure in the larger parking lot? Are exterior doors secured by a lock or code outside business hours?
